name: Majo no Yume
source:
There is a place feared as "Witch Forest". It's believed that witch lived there and planted "Night Flower" to protect her. Did night traveler know this legend or came there completely unaware? Whatever the reason, we will face the consequences.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一片被人们畏惧地称为“魔女之森”的地方。相传，一位魔女曾住在那里，并种下“夜之花”来保护自己。那位夜行的旅人是知道这个传说才来的，还是对此毫不知情？无论缘由如何，我们都将面对随之而来的结果。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
